author: ex_optic
body:
Today I have just finished up my map that I have been working on for around 1-2 months.

The map "Thanos" has a twist to it. At first it was going to be a galaxy, but then I decided to create another planet, "Thanos". You first spawn in a little arch way, you then begin to walk out on red and orange clay and sand. There are 3 lootable places:
1. A Tree
2. A Pyramid
3. A Small Palace
There is also Mid, and a few other scattered chests.
I would just like to state, this map is not very OP however, it is not very "normal" It has a few OP items, like mid bow, a bow in a cave, some potions (no strength), and one pickaxe. Finding these all together will make you OP I guess.

Here is the downloadable link for the map:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/37zwt2lkgj6nbog/Copy%20of%20The%20Walls%20-%20PvP%20Survival%20-%2015%20mi...

And here is the link to the Album:
http://imgur.com/a/qhlUK#0

PS. Polar told me he would copy and paste the quad into the rest of the 3. So when you download the map, it will only be 1 of the quads.
